intent: Establish an immutable door v1 execution-bundle release boundary before any future semantic v2 so persisted access-control work remains routable by exact identity and unknown non-terminal state fails closed.
invariants: Current door v1 PlanID, PlanVersion and PlanDigest are an immutable release identity; semantic plan or handler changes under the same identity are rejected by tests.
Every non-terminal persisted door execution is dispatched only to the execution bundle matching its PlanDigest and version-specific human/reconciliation bindings.
New door executions start only on the active bundle.
Unknown or mismatched non-terminal door bundle identity fails Open or Serve preflight closed.
Terminal historical door records do not require executable retained bundles and do not block startup.
Unlock approval and ambiguous-side-effect reconciliation resolve through the persisted execution bundle, never unconditional current-plan engine/constants.
A future distinct active bundle can coexist with retained v1 through Axiom Host without introducing a fake semantic v2 in production today.
Resource ownership and external-effect idempotency remain preserved across restart and bundle routing.
contracts: repository history characterization confirms no semantic door predecessor beyond current v1 and formatting normalization
golden door v1 digest is deterministic on the pinned Axiom revision
bundle metadata pins plan, Registry/handlers and unlock/reconciliation node bindings
Axiom Host owns active and retained engines over the existing Production Store/Router
Start uses active bundle while Drive and human/reconciliation operations resolve persisted identity first
Open or synchronous Serve preflight validates every non-terminal persisted door execution
an internal constructor/test seam can register retained v1 plus a distinct test active bundle without changing public production semantics
acceptance_evidence: golden v1 identity test fails on plan digest drift
memory or Pebble test proves current v1 Start/Drive behavior remains unchanged
Pebble restart preserves a waiting unlock approval and resolves it through the matching bundle without duplicate physical action
ambiguous-side-effect reconciliation after restart resolves through the matching bundle
unknown/mismatched non-terminal persisted digest fails closed while terminal history does not block startup
internal multi-bundle test proves retained v1 and distinct future-active bundle can coexist and route by digest
Gremlins produces non-empty door orchestration evidence with zero lived/not-covered/timeout critical blockers
